projects.projectName: Premera Blue Cross - Producer Portal Development - Phase 1

riskDescription.context: The project has absorbed approximately 14 scope changes equivalent to 0.75–1 sprint of additional effort
riskDescription.condition: Further scope additions may occur without formal change control
riskDescription.consequence: Delivery timelines may be impacted and project margin eroded

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Implement formal change control procedure requiring impact assessment and customer approval before accepting any new scope additions.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Upon approval of scope changes exceeding 0.5 sprint effort, rebaseline project timeline and escalate to program leadership within 48 hours.

riskDescription.context: Integration with live Data Hub APIs is still pending
riskDescription.condition: Performance and NFR issues will only become visible after integration
riskDescription.consequence: Late discovery of performance defects may delay UAT and Go-Live

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Conduct daily collaboration with Data Hub team and execute performance baseline testing immediately upon API availability in ACPT environment.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Should performance issues surface during integration testing, activate dedicated performance tuning team and defer non-critical features to Phase 2.

riskDescription.context: Availability of Data Hub API delivery by 6/30 is uncertain
riskDescription.condition: Any delay in Data Hub API delivery beyond June 30
riskDescription.consequence: Delivery timelines will be impacted and integration testing delayed

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Establish weekly status reviews with Data Hub team and maintain synthetic data testing environment to enable parallel development activities.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Once Data Hub delivery delay exceeds two weeks, implement phased delivery approach prioritizing critical-path functionality and escalate to Premera program leadership.
